newsitem.title: USA: High Plains Wheat - Basis bids strengthen further.
newsitem.headline: High Plains Wheat - Basis bids strengthen further.

text.p: Basis bids for hard red winter wheat strengthened further Thursday at the Gulf of Mexico and at scattered locations throughout Kansas and Oklahoma, dealers in the central U.S. High Plains said Friday.
"There are boats to load but no wheat," one Kansas dealer said, explaining the firmness at the Gulf. "It's not any new sales. They've already got business on the books."
Dealers said movement had been extremely slow Thursday.
"Very dead," another Kansas dealer said. "Monday was the best day this week. We probably took more wheat Monday than on any two days during the rest of the week."

Oklahoma dealers said fields were beginning to dry out after having received several inches of rainfall this week. But one dealer cautioned that there were forecasts for more rain this weekend in northern Oklahoma.
Basis values in cents/bu against KCBT wheat, cash=dollars/bu.
